required_coverage.population: U.S. Compustat firm-years eligible under the paper’s Compustat cash-flow-history rule, including FF48 industry-year peer cells.

routes.mapping_notes: Annual Compustat raw fields are semantically mapped using the paper’s definitions and live catalog labels: IB/income before extraordinary items, OANCF/operating cash flow, SALE, RECT, PPEGT/gross PPE, AT, PRCC_F, CSHO and CEQ. routes.coverage_notes: The exact file and columns were read by the shared bounded probe. No coordinator coverage confirmation supports complete firm-year history or the 1994–2003 sample population; local historical coverage remains unverified.
